title: Per-catalog themes and launch options

cards.title: Upcoming Supporter Features
cards.body:
*A quick note about where Shift is headed*

Honestly, Shift already does more than I imagined when I first started building it for myself. At this point *it covers everything I personally need from a launcher*, and then some.

That said, I'd still like to keep adding features and fixing things as they come up, and that takes real time to keep up with. So an upcoming update will introduce Supporter Features: a one-time unlock for a set of non-essential extras.

To be clear about what this means: the core Shift experience, everything that makes it work as your launcher, will always stay free. What becomes part of Supporter Features is stuff on top of that: extra themes and visual customization, and a handful of other non-essential extras, including a few things that are currently existing today.

*This isn't landing right away*, it's still being worked on, and I'll share more details once it's closer to ready.

*Thanks for sticking with Shift*. Feedback and feature requests still matter more than anything else.

cards.title: Per-catalog themes
cards.body:
Each store catalog (Xbox, Steam, Epic, GOG) is a different list of games, and a layout that suits one often doesn't suit another.

Turn on *Per-Catalog themes* in *Settings > Visuals > Theme* to give each catalog its own theme and theme settings, separate from the main grid.

Off by default, and a catalog follows the main grid until you change something inside it.

cards.title: Launch options
cards.body:
Set per-game command-line arguments right from a game's own menu.

Open *Game Menu > Tools*, then pick from quick preset chips for common flags or type your own.

Supported on Steam, GOG, Xbox, and custom apps.

changelog: New: *Per-catalog theme + settings*, check out Settings > Visuals > Theme, off by default.
New: *Launch options*. Per-game command-line args from Game Menu > Tools.
Shelf theme: store-logo shimmer while loading, and a title placeholder for games with no artwork at all.
Fixed a second controller occasionally going dead right after Shift refocuses.
Fixed a catalog's background sometimes staying on screen after leaving it.
Fixed Epic forcing re-sign-in when just offline/slow, plus other slow-connection fixes.
Fixed REFramework detection (Onimusha WotS etc.) and its _storage_ shadow folder.
Welcome Tour: highlights are now more reliable when flipping cards quickly.
Several other bug fixes, and UI polish.
